## Details

<a id="level_row_delays"></a>
### [`level_row_delays`](../../../../src/engine/row_delay.asm#L6) `$8065-$8069`

*data*

Delay after each scanned row, one byte for each level 1-5. A larger value gives a slower game.

- **Read by:** [`init_cave_state`](../cave/setup.md#init_cave_state)

<a id="scan_row_delay"></a>
### [`scan_row_delay`](../../../../src/engine/row_delay.asm#L9) `$806A`

*routine*

Waits after a scanned row: row_delay times 16 loop steps. Changes X and Y.

- **Called from:** [`scan_cave`](cave_scan.md#scan_cave)
- **Reads:** [`row_delay`](../../memory-map.md#row_delay)
